Goal: $1. Next step, deadlines and application status in one place.
^«(.+)» manzilida sahifa yo'q\. Havola eskirgan yoki xato yozilgan bo'lishi mumkin\. Quyidagi bo'limlardan birini tanlang:$
There is no page at «$1». The link may be outdated or mistyped. Choose one of the sections below:
^(\d+) ta idora topildi · hujjatlar ro'yxati bor: (\d+)$
^© (\d+) Uniroad\. Ma'lumotlar oxirgi marta (.+) da yangilandi\.$
^Summalar davlat minimumi \((.+)\)\. Viloyat bundan ko'p berishi mumkin\. Eng katta summa oilasidan uzoqda yashaydigan \(fuori sede\) va oila daromadi eng past talabaga beriladi\.$
Amounts are the state minimum ($1). The region may give more. The largest amount goes to a student living away from their family (fuori sede) with the lowest family income.
^Bir o'quv yili uchun bankda \(sizning yoki homiyingiz hisobida\) bo'lishi kerak\. Bu pul sarflanmaydi, faqat ko'rsatiladi\. (.+) talabi\.$
Must be in the bank for one academic year (in your or your sponsor's account). This money is not spent, only shown. Requirement for $1.
^Qabul ma'lumotlari rasmiy sahifalardan (.+) da tekshirildi\. «O'tgan yil» deb belgilangan sanalar mo'ljal uchun: 2027/28 sanalari e'lon qilinganda yangilanadi\.$
Admission information was checked against official pages on $1. Dates marked «last year» are for reference: they will be updated when the 2027/28 dates are announced.
^kamida (.+) / yil \(fuori sede, eng kam daromadli oila, (.+)\)$
at least $1 / year (fuori sede, lowest-income family, $2)

^Ma'lumotlar har hafta rasmiy manbalardan \(universitetlar, MUR, elchixona, DSU\) AI yordamida tekshiriladi; har bir sana rasmiy manba bilan tasdiqlanganidan keyingina saytga va kalendar obunalariga qo'shiladi\. Oxirgi yangilanish: (.+)$

Data is checked every week against official sources (universities, MUR, embassy, DSU) with AI help; each date is added to the site and calendar subscriptions only after it is confirmed by an official source. Last updated: $1

ISEE parificato: family income and assets, ISEE up to $1 and ISPE up to $2
ISEE up to $1 (state maximum; check the bando)

$1 universities: state and private universities on the Italian Ministry of Education (MUR) list. Search by name or city.
